$comment: Cross-browser policy (BROWSER-REGRESSION-QA-PROTOCOL.md sec 36). Do not claim 'cross-browser verified' after testing only Chromium.

primary_smoke.rationale: Chromium alone is acceptable for the required smoke matrix on standard builds.

release_critical_subset.applies_to: The interaction subset (navigation, forms, consent UI, route transitions, reduced motion) before production pre-flight.
release_critical_subset.rationale: WebKit and Gecko diverge on focus, form autofill, View Transitions, and prefers-reduced-motion behaviour.

project_override.rationale: A project may require an explicit browser set (e.g. an internal tool that only ships to Chromium). Record the reason here.

engine_selection.note: The engine is BROWSER_QA_ENGINE and is replaceable. simulation is deterministic and dependency-free; playwright is the reference real-browser adapter. An unavailable engine yields BLOCKED with a reason, never a PASS.
